notes: Fixed: some addon icons were missing in Browse. Easier keys: paste a CurseForge or Wago key and it's recognised, checked and saved by itself (first start shows the paste box right on My addons). Quieter: "no WoW Forever file" is said once per addon instead of at every check. Other folders: hand-installed addons are also looked up on Wago (with a Manage with updates button), and library folders say which addons use them. Starts faster: the program keeps a compiled copy of itself.
